;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Mali War]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in Mali]]
**[[Spain]] evacuates its [[Spanish Army|troops]] from [[Mali]] after several soldiers become infected with COVID-19. The troops were part of the [[European Union]]'s [[European Union Training Mission in Mali|EUTM Mali]] training mission. [https://www.theolivepress.es/spain-news/2020/04/15/more-than-100-spanish-soldiers-evacuated-from-mali-after-coronavirus-outbreak/ (''The Olive Press'')]
*[[Terrorism in the United States]]
**A 36-year-old man is arrested for attempting to firebomb a Jewish assisted living facility in [[Longmeadow, Massachusetts]] on April 3. His arrest is part of a larger investigation into a [[white supremacist]] group suspected of plotting mass killings online. He is charged with two counts of attempted arson, but is released the next day. [https://www.huffpost.com/entry/john-michael-rathbun-arrested-jewish-nursing-home-arson-massachuetts_n_5e988e67c5b6ead1400972ee?ncid=NEWSSTAND0005 (''HuffPost'')] [https://www.wwlp.com/news/local-news/hampden-county/man-arrested-in-connection-with-attempted-arson-at-longmeadow-jewish-living-facility-released/ (WWLP)]
*According to the [[United States Navy]], a [[Russia]]n [[Sukhoi Su-35|SU-35]] fighter jet intercepts a U.S. Navy [[Boeing P-8 Poseidon|P-8A Poseidon]], [[Anti-submarine warfare|anti-submarine]] and [[Anti-surface warfare|anti-surface warfare]] aircraft, flying over the [[Mediterranean Sea]]. [https://www.businessinsider.com/russian-jet-buzzes-us-aircraft-inverted-2020-4 (''Business Insider'')] 

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2020 Easter tornado outbreak]]
**The death toll in a tornado outbreak that devastated the [[Southeastern United States]] on April 12–13 rises to 35. [https://www.whsv.com/content/news/One-of-several-Mississippi-tornadoes-from-Easter-Sunday-at-least-2-miles-wide-569673871.html (WHSV-TV)]
*Fourteen people are injured in a chain-reaction accident involving up to 60 vehicles, during the morning rush hour on [[Chicago]]'s [[Kennedy Expressway]], as unseasonable, wintry weather strikes the city. None of the injuries is considered life-threatening. At least 32 others are treated at the scene. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/chicago-highway-crash-involves-nearly-60-cars-14-brought-hospitals-n1184186 (NBC News)] [https://www.accuweather.com/en/winter-weather/major-pileup-crash-in-chicago-amid-wintry-weather/721482 (Accuweather)]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***The death toll from [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] in the [[United States]] rises by 2,371 in a single day to 30,800, the highest number of COVID-19 linked deaths reported in any country in a single day, as total cases rise to 635,000. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-usa-casualties/u-s-coronavirus-deaths-increase-by-record-amount-for-second-straight-day-reuters-tally-idUKKCN21X2XA (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]]
***[[France]] reports 1,438 more deaths from COVID-19, the highest daily death toll in the country to date, bringing the country's death toll to 17,167 with 133,470 total cases. The latest figures include deaths from COVID-19 in care homes over the three-day [[Easter]] weekend. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-health-coronavirus-france/french-coronavirus-toll-jumps-by-record-1438-deaths-idUKKCN21X2YG?il=0 (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic on naval ships]]
****The French [[Ministry of Armed Forces (France)|Ministry of Armed Forces]] reports 668 sailors, more than a third of the crew of its [[flagship]] aircraft carrier [[French aircraft carrier Charles de Gaulle|''Charles de Gaulle'']], have tested positive for COVID-19. [https://www.france24.com/en/20200415-a-third-of-french-aircraft-carrier-crew-have-covid-19-says-defence-ministry (France 24)]

;International relations
*[[United States|U.S.]] officials say China may have conducted [[Tactical nuclear weapon|low-yield nuclear weapon]] tests in its [[Lop Nur]] test site in violation of the [[Comprehensive Nuclear-Test-Ban Treaty]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-china-nuclear/china-may-have-conducted-low-level-nuclear-test-blasts-us-says-idUSKCN21X386 (Reuters)]
*According to [[United States Space Command]], Russia conducts a direct-ascent [[Anti-satellite weapon|anti-satellite]] missile test. [https://www.cnbc.com/2020/04/15/russia-tests-anti-satellite-missile-us-general-says.html (CNBC)] [https://www.airforcemag.com/russia-flexes-space-muscle-with-anti-satellite-weapon-test/ (''Air Force Magazine'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 South Korean legislative election]]
**Elections for the 21st [[National Assembly (South Korea)|National Assembly]] of [[South Korea]] are held amidst [[COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea|the coronavirus pandemic]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-52275993 (BBC News)]
**Turnout is at 66.2 percent, the highest in a legislative election since [[1992 South Korean legislative election|1992]]. [https://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2020/04/15/High-voter-turnout-in-South-Korea-elections-despite-COVID-19-crisis/1261586942746/ (United Press International)]
**The ruling [[Democratic Party (South Korea, 1955)|Democratic Party]] and its affiliate [[Together Citizens' Party]] are projected to win 180 seats, a record high for any political parties in South Korean history. [https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20200415005856315?section=national/politics (Yonhap News Agency)]
**The leader of the main opposition [[United Future Party]], [[Hwang Kyo-ahn]] resigns from his post after his party's defeat. [https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/www/nation/2020/04/356_288004.html (''The Korea Times'')]
**[[Thae Yong-ho]] becomes the first ever [[North Korean defectors|North Korean defector]] to be elected to a constituency seat, representing [[Seoul]]'s [[Gangnam District]] in the National Assembly. [https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/www/nation/2020/04/356_287997.html (''The Korea Times'')]

;Sports
*The [[2020 Tour de France]] is delayed until August due to the COVID-19 pandemic. [https://edition.cnn.com/2020/04/15/sport/tour-de-france-macron-postponement-coronavirus-spt-intl/index.html (CNN)]
